mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, paired with a lovely Waning Crescent moon.

The City of Verona keeps us updated with regular engineering reports, and if you are looking for summer work, the Rec Department is currently accepting applications for positions like adult fitness instructors.

There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music today at Bailey is Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena, and yoga classes at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a police report from July 28, officers located a parked vehicle in Fireman is Park after hours, resulting in a 29-year-old man being taken into custody for an active arrest warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. Culver is is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when they open at 10 AM today.
